<a id="page-paint"></a>
# Custom paint

Drawing with paths, shapes, text and images on a node's canvas: a `customPaint` line and its op lines. Open it
when a UI needs an illustration, a chart of its own, a dial or any shape the boxes cannot make.

<a id="paint-the-lines"></a>
## The lines

A `customPaint` line under the node that paints carries the painter's own keys; each line under it is one draw op,
in order, over the node's own fill and border and under its children; a `foregroundPainter` line (under the
`customPaint` line, or under the node beside it) holds the ops drawn over the children too. A rectangle with round
corners is `rrect rect=[left,top,width,height] radius=4` (not `rect x= y= w= h=`); a shape's opacity is its
colour's alpha (`fill=#80FF0000`). An op line is the op's name, a
quoted string first where it has one (a `paragraph`'s text, an `image`'s URL), and its fields by their own names.
Its paint is `fill=<color>` (fills the shape) and `stroke=<color>` with the stroke's keys beside it
(`strokeWidth`, `strokeCap`, `strokeJoin`, `dashPattern`); `paint={…}` for a paint they cannot say. A field of a record
field is its dotted path, as on a node's line: `paragraph "Q3" style.fontSize=11 style.color=#FF6B7280`. A `group` or
a `repeat` holds the op lines under it; inside a `repeat`, `index` and `item` are the copy's.

```notation
box w=200 h=120
  customPaint viewBox=[200,120]
    rect rect=[0,0,200,120] fill=#FFE8F1F8
    circle c=[100,60] radius=28 fill=#FFF4B740
    line p1=[0,110] p2=[200,110] stroke=#FF5D6D7E strokeWidth=2
```

A value is a number, a word, a quoted string, JSON, or `{expression}`; a list may hold expressions among its
numbers: `c=[{60 + index * 34},48]`.

A chart of your own, drawn from the state: a `repeat` over the data, each copy a bar and its label placed by
`index`. The `viewBox` is the drawing's own units; `fit=fill` stretches it to the box.

```notation
state sales=[40,72,55,90,64]
box h=160
  customPaint viewBox=[250,120] fit=fill
    line p1=[0,119] p2=[250,119] stroke=#FFD1D5DB strokeWidth=1
    repeat count={length(sales)}
      rrect rect=[{index * 50 + 10},{120 - sales[index]},30,{sales[index]}] radius=4 fill={index == length(sales) - 1 ? '#FF2563EB' : '#FF93C5FD'}
      paragraph "{sales[index]}" offset=[{index * 50 + 10},{104 - sales[index]}] maxWidth=30 textAlign=center
```

For a bar, line or donut chart with axes and a legend, the chart words (`BarChart`, `LineChart`, `Donut`) on
[charts.md](charts.md) are shorter.

<a id="paint-the-painter-s-keys"></a>
## The painter's keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `viewBox` | [Rect](values.md#type-Rect) |  | The ops' coordinates, [width, height] or [minX, minY, width, height], mapped onto the box by fit. Null: box pixels. |
| `fit` | `fill` `contain` `cover` `fitWidth` `fitHeight` `none` `scaleDown` | `fill` | How the view box maps onto the box. |
| `isComplex` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Raster cache hint: the drawing is costly. |
| `willChange` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Raster cache hint: the drawing changes often. |

<a id="paint-the-ops"></a>
## The ops

Every op also takes these:

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text |  | Stable name: editor selection and binding paths (customPaint.painter.<id>.<field>). |
| `when` | `true`/`false` |  | Drawn only while it holds. |

<a id="paint-op-path"></a>
### `path`: Path

Flutter `Canvas.drawPath`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `d` | text |  | SVG path data. |
| `commands` | list of JSON |  | Without d: Path builder calls ({"moveTo": [x, y]}, lineTo, quadraticBezierTo, cubicTo, {"close": true}), each number a literal or an expression, each call with an optional "when". |
| `points` | list of [Offset](values.md#type-Offset) |  | Without d or commands: points joined by straight lines ([[x, y], ...]; null breaks the line). |
| `close` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Points: back to the first one. |
| `fillType` | `nonZero` `evenOdd` | `nonZero` |  |
| `trimStart` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0` | Drawn from this share of its length. |
| `trimEnd` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` | Drawn up to this share of its length. |
| `paint` | list of `DrawPaint` | `[]` | Each paint draws the shape once, in order (Flutter's Paint). None: an invisible hit region. |
| `hit` | text |  | Makes the shape a hit region: pointer reactions get its id as ${result.region}. |

<a id="paint-op-group"></a>
### `group`: Group

Flutter `Canvas.save … restore`. Transforms, clips and a layer around its ops.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ops` | list of JSON | `[]` |  |
| `translate` | [Offset](values.md#type-Offset) |  | canvas.translate(dx, dy). |
| `scale` | list of number |  | canvas.scale(sx, `sy`). |
| `rotate` | number |  | canvas.rotate(radians). |
| `transform` | list of number |  | canvas.transform: a Matrix4's 16 numbers, column-major. |
| `clipRect` | [Rect](values.md#type-Rect) |  |  |
| `clipRRect` | `DrawRRect` |  |  |
| `clipPath` | text |  | SVG path data. |
| `opacity` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` | Below 1: a layer (saveLayer). |
| `blendMode` | [BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode) | `srcOver` | Not srcOver: a layer blended so. |

<a id="paint-op-repeat"></a>
### `repeat`: Repeat

Flutter `for (final (index, item) in list.indexed)`. Its ops once per item (${item}, ${index}, ${count}).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `each` | text |  | An expression giving the list (${cells}). |
| `count` | number (≥ 0) |  | Without each: how many times. |
| `as` | text | `"item"` | The item's name inside. |
| `indexAs` | text | `"index"` | The position's name inside. |
| `ops` | list of JSON | `[]` |  |

<a id="paint-behaviors"></a>
## Keys any line takes here

<a id="behavior-customPaint"></a>
### `customPaint` (behavior)

Flutter's `CustomPaint`: draw lists behind and over the content.

Written `customPaint={…}` on any line ([CustomPaint](#type-CustomPaint)). Level 4.
 Each field of its record (CustomPaint) is a key of its own, dotted: `customPaint.painter=…`.

<a id="type-CustomPaint"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customPaint.painter` | list of JSON | `[]` | Drawn over the node's own fill and border, under its children (CustomPaint.painter). |
| `customPaint.foregroundPainter` | list of JSON | `[]` | Drawn over the node's content (CustomPaint.foregroundPainter). |
| `customPaint.viewBox` | [Rect](values.md#type-Rect) |  | The ops' coordinates, [width, height] or [minX, minY, width, height], mapped onto the box by fit. Null: box pixels. |
| `customPaint.fit` | `fill` `contain` `cover` `fitWidth` `fitHeight` `none` `scaleDown` | `fill` | How the view box maps onto the box. |
| `customPaint.isComplex` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Raster cache hint: the drawing is costly. |
| `customPaint.willChange` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Raster cache hint: the drawing changes often. |
